package answer

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type startAnswerRepoStub struct {
	active       *domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	created      *domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	createCalled int
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) Create(_ context.Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer, _ *int) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	stub.createCalled++
	copy := answer
	copy.Attempt = 1
	stub.created = &copy
	return copy, nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) Update(context.Context, domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	return nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) GetByID(context.Context, string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) GetActiveForTaskAndStudent(context.Context, string, string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	if stub.active == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := *stub.active
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) ListForTaskAndStudent(context.Context, string, string) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) CountForTaskAndStudent(context.Context, string, string) (int, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) ListForStudent(context.Context, string, int, int) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) CountForStudent(context.Context, string) (int, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (stub *startAnswerRepoStub) GetProgressByTaskIDs(context.Context, string, []string) (map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, error) {
	return map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{}, nil
}

type sandboxCreatorStub struct {
	lastTaskID   string
	lastAnswerID string
	sandboxID    string
	previewURL   string
}

func (stub *sandboxCreatorStub) CreateSandbox(_ context.Context, _ string, taskID, answerID string, _ []byte, _ string, _ []byte, _ string) (string, string, error) {
	stub.lastTaskID = taskID
	stub.lastAnswerID = answerID
	return stub.sandboxID, stub.previewURL, nil
}

type eventPublisherStub struct{}

func (eventPublisherStub) Publish(string, any) error { return nil }

type projectRuntimeBridgeStub struct {
	bindCalls     int
	lastAnswerID  string
	lastSandboxID string
}

func (stub *projectRuntimeBridgeStub) BindAnswer(_ context.Context, _ string, _ string, answerID, sandboxID string, _ *string) error {
	stub.bindCalls++
	stub.lastAnswerID = answerID
	stub.lastSandboxID = sandboxID
	return nil
}

func (stub *projectRuntimeBridgeStub) FinalizeAnswer(context.Context, string, bool, map[string]any, *string, *string, *string) error {
	return nil
}

func TestStartTaskAnswer_RegularCourseTaskDoesNotUsePracticeTaskRuntimeBridge(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &startAnswerRepoStub{}
	sandbox := &sandboxCreatorStub{
		sandboxID:  "sandbox-course-1",
		previewURL: "https://preview.localhost/course-task",
	}
	runtimeBridge := &projectRuntimeBridgeStub{}
	provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{
		tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
			"task-1": {
				ID:              "task-1",
				LessonID:        "lesson-1",
				CourseID:        "course-1",
				Status:          domain.TaskStatusActive,
				Type:            1,
				RequiresSandbox: true,
				ExposesPreview:  true,
				ExecutionMode:   "BROWSER_PREVIEW",
				EvaluationMode:  "AUTO",
				UIMode:          "PREVIEW",
				SubmissionMode:  "SNAPSHOT",
			},
		},
		structure: &CourseStructure{
			CourseID: "course-1",
			Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
				{
					ID:     "lesson-1",
					Order:  1,
					Status: 1,
					Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{
						{
							ID:             "task-1",
							LessonID:       "lesson-1",
							CourseID:       "course-1",
							Order:          1,
							Status:         1,
							EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						},
					},
				},
			},
		},
	}

	uc := StartTaskAnswer{
		TaskProvider:   provider,
		Answers:        repo,
		Publisher:      eventPublisherStub{},
		SandboxCreator: sandbox,
		Progression: &ProgressionService{
			TaskProvider: provider,
			Answers:      repo,
		},
		PracticeTaskRuntime: runtimeBridge,
	}

	result, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), StartTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID: "user-1",
		TaskID:    "task-1",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.AnswerID == "" || repo.createCalled != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected a new regular course answer to be created")
	}
	if runtimeBridge.bindCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("practice-task runtime bridge should not be used for regular course tasks")
	}
	if sandbox.lastTaskID != "task-1" || sandbox.lastAnswerID != result.AnswerID {
		t.Fatalf("sandbox create called with unexpected ids: task=%s answer=%s", sandbox.lastTaskID, sandbox.lastAnswerID)
	}
}

func TestStartTaskAnswer_ReusesActivePracticeTaskAnswerOnReopen(t *testing.T) {
	active := &domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
		ID:        "answer-active-1",
		StudentID: "user-1",
		TaskID:    "workspace-task-1",
		Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress,
		StartedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	repo := &startAnswerRepoStub{active: active}
	sandbox := &sandboxCreatorStub{
		sandboxID:  "sandbox-shared-1",
		previewURL: "https://preview.localhost/practice-task",
	}
	runtimeBridge := &projectRuntimeBridgeStub{}
	provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{
		tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
			"workspace-task-1": {
				ID:                    "workspace-task-1",
				LessonID:              "workspace-lesson-1",
				CourseID:              "project-1",
				Status:                domain.TaskStatusActive,
				Type:                  10,
				TaskKind:              "practice_task_milestone",
				RequiresSandbox:       true,
				ExposesPreview:        true,
				ExecutionMode:         "BROWSER_PREVIEW",
				EvaluationMode:        "AUTO",
				UIMode:                "PREVIEW",
				SubmissionMode:        "SNAPSHOT",
				IsPracticeTaskRuntime: true,
			},
		},
	}

	uc := StartTaskAnswer{
		TaskProvider:        provider,
		Answers:             repo,
		Publisher:           eventPublisherStub{},
		SandboxCreator:      sandbox,
		PracticeTaskRuntime: runtimeBridge,
	}

	result, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), StartTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID: "user-1",
		TaskID:    "workspace-task-1",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if repo.createCalled != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected reopen to reuse active answer instead of creating a new one")
	}
	if result.AnswerID != "answer-active-1" {
		t.Fatalf("answer id = %s, want active answer id", result.AnswerID)
	}
	if runtimeBridge.bindCalls != 1 || runtimeBridge.lastAnswerID != "answer-active-1" {
		t.Fatalf("runtime bind should reuse active answer, got calls=%d answer=%s", runtimeBridge.bindCalls, runtimeBridge.lastAnswerID)
	}
	if sandbox.lastTaskID != "workspace-task-1" || sandbox.lastAnswerID != "answer-active-1" {
		t.Fatalf("sandbox reopen called with unexpected ids: task=%s answer=%s", sandbox.lastTaskID, sandbox.lastAnswerID)
	}
}
